decision.summary: A coherent multi-sample upward offset in N and U begins near index 480–490, with E lagging but following; the offset persists through ~520 and shows only partial recovery by 539, without a confirmed opposing return within allowed context [445,579]. No other temporary offsets are supported by axis-coherent onset/sustained/return evidence in this region.

intervals.observation: N and U rise coherently from ~480–490, sustained through ~520; E shows delayed but correlated upward trend. Return is incomplete: values at 539 remain elevated relative to pre-480 baseline, with no clear opposing shift observed before end of allowed context (579). Cross-axis coherence supports real motion, but absence of full return makes status uncertain.
